versions.subject: rule: Exchange Exploitation
versions.detection:
selection_origin:
    - Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
    - ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '&ipconfig&echo'
        - '&quser&echo'
        - '&whoami&echo'
        - '&c:&echo'
        - '&cd&echo'
        - '&dir&echo'
        - '&echo [E]'
        - '&echo [S]'
condition: all of selection*
